label: Griffin A
identity_view: front, front-right oblique, right profile, rear-right oblique, back
description: The exact native flying griffin: compact brown lion hindquarters, two brown rear legs with red-brown claw tips, long thin brown tail ending in a small green feather tuft. Feathered muted dark teal-green eagle head, neck, broad breast and shoulders; two narrow pointed green head tufts, small dark alert eyes, hooked golden-yellow beak with an orange underside. Two large eagle wings with green upper coverts, dark shaded feather bases and long muted olive-gray flight feathers with pale subdued tips. Two golden ochre scaled eagle forelegs with long dark hooked talons. Preserve four legs plus two wings: eagle forefeet and feline hindfeet, their exact native pose and foreshortening. Keep the short neck, small head, bulky bird breast, lean brown feline rear body, native wing span and feather layering. Native upper-left baked lighting, dark restrained tonal weight, no bright rim light. Only colored plumage/tail tuft and flight feathers change in native palettes; preserve native brown fur, golden beak, scales, eyes and claws. No saddle, armor, rider, harness, jewelry, new limbs, effects, background shadow or redesign.
